name: wordOrLetterCounter
description: Counts the frequency of words or letters in a given text and returns the top or lowest N based on the count.

mode.description: Specify whether to count words or letters.

topN.description: The number of top or lowest occurring items to return.

order.description: Whether to return the top or lowest N occurrences.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the counting should be case-sensitive.

code: ({ inputString, mode, topN, order, caseSensitive = false }) => { const processText = caseSensitive ? inputString : inputString.toLowerCase(); let frequencyMap = {}; if (mode === 'words') { const words = processText.match(/\b\w+\b/g) || []; words.forEach(word => { frequencyMap[word] = (frequencyMap[word] || 0) + 1; }); } else if (mode === 'letters') { const letters = processText.replace(/\s+/g, '').split(''); letters.forEach(letter => { frequencyMap[letter] = (frequencyMap[letter] || 0) + 1; }); } const sortedEntries = Object.entries(frequencyMap).sort((a, b) => order === 'top' ? b[1] - a[1] : a[1] - b[1]); return sortedEntries.slice(0, topN); }
